title: Coefficient normalization implies semilinear normalization
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W. For the integral coefficient sheaves B and their quotient transitions τ, let scalar assign ScalarData for every coefficient map B_m → B_n. If a derived coefficient sequence M satisfies IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence, meaning its actual derived transitions induce bijections Hom(M_n,P) → Hom(M_m,res P) for every n ≤ m and P, then it satisfies SemilinearSections.Normalized with these scalar models: every scalar-extension adjunct of the actual transition is an isomorphism.

source.place: Construction 4.1, normalized coefficient systems and their derived scalar-extension criterion; Stacks 0941.

proof.text: The map of the quotient coefficient sequence under forgetting commutative-ring structure equals the sequence of the ring maps. The finite composite map formula therefore identifies generic scalar restriction with normalizedDVRModuleRes. The unique sectionwise restriction descriptions of the generic and coefficient transitions identify their underlying functions and then the natural transformations. Functorial localization transports the same identification to their derived transitions.

Transport the coefficient normalization Hom-bijections across the preceding derived restriction and transition identifications. Under each scalar adjunction, naturality identifies precomposition by the transition adjunct with this bijection followed by the adjunction hom-equivalence. Hence this precomposition is bijective for every target. The Mathlib coyoneda criterion makes the adjunct an isomorphism, which is exactly semilinear normalization.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Construction 4.1; explicit interface identification and adjunction/coyoneda proof by U6, 2026-10-28.

theorem coefficientNormalizedSequence_semilinear
    (scalar : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      SemilinearSections.ScalarData.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)}
        (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W)
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingTransition l E W) h))
    (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W) (hM : IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W M) :
    SemilinearSections.Normalized (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W)
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingTransition l E W) scalar M
